correctness.rationale: The completed repair replaces the unordered set in the frozen boxed sum by three indexed gaps, preserving their multiplicities. Literally summing over the set {a,b,c} was false when gaps coincide: (2,2,2) gives Phi=3 but the literal display gives 2; the frozen proof already used the three separate contributions. The corrected formula agrees with that proof and preserves all other claims. A one-bearing factor has at most two alignments, so only 1 qualifies; the three zero runs and strict cutoff give the sharp endpoints with the stated witnesses including N=0 and N=1. The discrete sign test perturbs the continuous root by at most 3/N and discretization adds at most one grid cell. The uniform compositions converge to simplex area. Independently, taking the maximum over subsets in the root test gives 1-3t <= x_i <= 2t and t >= 1/4; area after translation and exclusion of disjoint caps gives the exact CDF, with the jump at 1/4 and no other jump. This derivation is in the repaired result. Reproduction: python3 /workspace/branches/reproductions/combinatorics.py verified 2925 literal words, the cutoff and extrema, and exact rational integration giving mass 1, mean 187/576, second moment 1499/13824 and variance 1007/331776. Weak convergence on a common bounded interval gives moment convergence. The reproduction does not prove the asymptotic step or describe other marker weights.
